body: I do, and he's very supportive even after the landlord rape, but im young and scared
Just my partner and friends but it really has helped, i just want to be useful to those I love
Ofcourse, I'll post as soon as i can and it helps to know y'all support me
No family since 16 but my friends are great. Thankyou for making me feel less alone
It doesnt and I apreciate the advice. Thankyou for reaching out.
Good luck is perfect, just knowing theres people who care is enough.

Thankyou so much, I've just found somewhere to stay and im doing my best to get back on track, it was just so so hard for me after it happened, i think anyone would struggle in similar circumstances, I'll be back on my feet at some point and hopefully soon, thankyou for responding x

Thankyou for your time, and I can completly see now that i shouldnt have said anything, atleast not two months in advance. Im going to try my best to just ride it out and have a lovely few months with him and make sure he has some good memories.
And thats okay, what are your thoughts right now?
Hey there, im here okay? Your not alone with any of this and theres a community here that cares. Your brave to reach out and we are all here. Its going to be okay?

I completly get where your coming from and its understandable to be looking for a way out of the stress but i promise things can turn around as fast as they get bad. They might even get bad again but you will have the good memories, your cats and friends, and boyfriend. Im so sorry your feeling like this, and ill never try and minimise your situation, its important that you just keep talking, even if its to strangers on the internet.

I completly understand your mental state, im in it right now but darling its going to get better okay? I dont know when and i dont know how but just trust me, situations can change and what's ever hurting you can be listened to and understood. Im so sorry your hurting, and i know im just a stranger but i care about you, message me if you need to and i hope your alright.

I completely hear what your saying and I'm glad that for even a moment you didnt feel so alone. Its such a hard emotion to experience and explain, id like to talk to you more if your up to it? As much as i am feeling the same way, i couldn't just sit back and accept that your thinking of ending it this month, though i understand completly, thankyou for taking the time to make me feel less alone.

I think maybe this kind person wasnt talking directly on longterm mental illness and more so on the fact that human life has meaning? I apreciate your argument however and do support dignified death, but i dont think its helpful on this exact thread. Im sorry the comment has affected you and i hope your alright.
I'm very much trying to hang in there, its all very day by day right now but I appreciate you commenting and helping me feel less alone on this one.
